remarks: Live the ultimate Greenwich lifestyle in this private sanctuary set on 3.02 park-like acres, featuring grounds designed by the visionary behind the Brooklyn Botanical Garden. A meticulous 2024 renovation beautifully preserved the estate's grand style while introducing a sleek, modern home complete with all the luxury amenities for today's living. Large, airy rooms are flooded with light from expansive windows showcasing views of the incredible gardens. The main house offers 4 BR, 3.2 BA, and 3 cozy fireplaces, while a separate 3-BR, 1-BA carriage house with a kitchen provides a flexible layout for a wellness studio, home office, or multigenerational living. Secluded yet minutes to everything- can do Short Term Rental as well
